purpose: Bounded primary-source triage for the unchanged white-sector covariance and square-root reader interface; not a proof import or a review of the pending WHITE_SECTOR_MATCHING source.
method: Two targeted arXiv-domain searches followed by three actual abstract/version pages and two bounded primary HTML windows.

sources.authors: David C. Brydges, G. Guadagni, P. K. Mitter
sources.title: Finite range Decomposition of Gaussian Processes
sources.actual_read: Abstract and version metadata only, returned page lines 8–30. No full-paper proof read for this checkpoint.
sources.stated_scope: Finite-range positive covariance decomposition for the lattice Laplacian resolvent, with a corollary for fractional Laplacian powers.
sources.coordinator_inference: This is relevant method background, but the checked abstract does not identify the actual finite-u gauge Hessian, full original-reader square root, or original white integration domain.

sources.title: Decay bounds for functions of matrices with banded or Kronecker structure
sources.actual_read: Abstract/version metadata lines 8–24 and primary HTML lines 52–155: introductory scope, matrix definitions and analytic/integral representations. No complete decay theorem or proof review.
sources.stated_scope: Hermitian banded/Kronecker and sparse-matrix function decay. The read preliminary section gives the inverse-square-root Cauchy–Stieltjes resolvent representation explicitly at line 144.
sources.coordinator_inference: Resolvent integration is a plausible way to build a square-root supplier from actual resolvent estimates. Entrywise decay alone does not establish the required complete original-reader coefficient norm, parameter locality, or contour-domain matching.

sources.title: Finite range decomposition for a general class of elliptic operators
sources.actual_read: Abstract/version metadata lines 8–25 and primary HTML lines 39–169: introduction, preliminary translation-invariant result, and start of the variable-coefficient hypotheses. The main new theorem and its proof were not checked.
sources.stated_scope: Gradient Gaussian fields and a variable-coefficient elliptic operator. The inspected setup uses zero-mean fields, uniform ellipticity, and scaled C3 coefficient control.
sources.coordinator_inference: The coefficient regularity method is relevant to background dependence. Those inspected hypotheses have not been matched to the actual finite-u gauge covariance, whose modes, roots, Haar factors and readers must be retained.

local_context.current_root_read: Lines 260–325, after locating SA15; earlier complete root source reading is retained but is not claimed as a fresh full reread.
local_context.observed_native_definition: SA14 already states the actual finite-u critical inverse square root via the resolvent integral with original readers. SA15 fixes b0=b(V,0), C0=[F0''(b0)]^-1/2 and the original scalar cube; SA16 retains the exact source-free full prefactor and truncated scalar Gaussian normalization.
